payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation systems for low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: The proposed VNBPE algorithm is used for effective Vietnamese word segmentation to alleviate the rare-word problem in NMT systems.
Back Translation and Mix-Source methods were adapted to improve the NMT systems' performance on the dataset.
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) was modified to address word segmentation issues in Japanese and Vietnamese for NMT.
